comparison.objective: Unload a part from a cycling shuttle during its pause without stopping the shuttle, versus adjust and validate a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception and part removal around moving equipment; candidate uses fine tool engagement and iterative parameter adjustment between guarded cycles.
comparison.success_condition: Part removed during a pause while cycling continues. Candidate instead requires isolation during adjustment and two post-adjustment stops within limits.
comparison.reason: Both involve cyclic machinery, but one tests timing around an operating shuttle while the other tests isolated component tuning followed by guarded validation.
